original_source_text: FPGAs are widely deployed in critical systems, but flaws in EDA toolchains can enable malicious HDL injection, leading to severe hardware vulnerabilities. We propose DefVul-Risk, an automated framework for assessing fault-injection risks in FPGA synthesis tools. It constructs a defect knowledge base, generates triggerable vulnerability samples via large language models, and fine-tunes risk-assessment models to prioritize high-risk defects. DefVul-Risk enhances toolchain security evaluation and vulnerability remediation efficiency. We submitted 26 CVE reports, with 9 officially confirmed.
